statistics_definition: All saved measured calls, including parser-rejected outputs. Median=statistics.median; p95=nearest rank ceil(.95*n). No interpolation. Generation timer excludes weight load, includes chat template/tokenization/copy/generate/decode. No inferred isolated CPU timings.

memory_units.allocated: absolute per-call inference peak, including resident weights

v1.hardware: Kaggle / 1 x Tesla T4 / cuda:0; host CPU identity not recorded
v1.weight_mode: 4-bit NF4 with double quantization; compute float16 (not full FP16 weights)
v1.warning: Outer wall time may include first lazy model load or prior smoke warmup; it is not an isolated retrieval/embedding measurement.

model_load_accounting: Never sum the per-row load attribute. V3 new and contaminated cohorts shared the same model instance/load (97.16118049 s); do not charge it twice. Smoke load metadata may refer to the same loaded object as batch; no summed session startup cost is claimed.
